name: Twitter Cards
description: Checks for Twitter/X Card meta tags (twitter:card, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image) with a valid card type, giving partial credit when only Open Graph tags exist. These tags control link previews on X and are extra structured metadata LLMs can read.

scoring.summary: Tags are read with meta[name="twitter:X"] falling back to meta[property="twitter:X"]. If none of twitter:card/title/description/image exist (null) but any og:title/og:description/og:image has non-empty content, return warning 2. Otherwise start at 3: -0.75 per missing required tag (card, title, description), -0.75 per present-but-empty (whitespace) required tag, -0.5 if twitter:image missing, -0.25 if twitter:card value not in [summary, summary_large_image, app, player]. finalScore = max(0, round(score*10)/10); status from finalScore; reported score = floor(finalScore).

rules.condition: getMetaContent(name): document.querySelector('meta[name="'+name+'"]') || document.querySelector('meta[property="'+name+'"]'); returns its content or null if no element
twitter:card, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image all null AND (og:title || og:description || og:image content truthy)
each required tag (card, title, description) missing (null)
each required tag present but content.trim() empty
twitter:image missing (null); empty twitter:image is NOT penalized
twitter:card truthy and not one of ['summary', 'summary_large_image', 'app', 'player'] (exact, case-sensitive)

scoring.status_mapping: Using decimal finalScore: >= 2.5 pass, >= 1.5 warning, else fail. Examples: all 4 tags valid => 3 pass; only image missing => 2.5 pass/2; invalid card type => 2.75 pass/2; one required missing => 2.25 warning/2 (1.75 warning/1 if image also missing); no twitter and no OG => 0.25 fail/0; OG-only => warning/2.

detect.source_procedure: Per page, collect twitter:* and og:* meta tags from the head. Static HTML / Vite: *.html, index.html. Astro: src/layouts/*.astro, SEO components (e.g. astro-seo props twitter={...}), src/components/**/Head*.astro. Hugo: layouts/partials/head*.html, including internal templates {{ template "_internal/twitter_cards.html" . }} and "_internal/opengraph.html" (these emit twitter:card, twitter:title, twitter:description, and twitter:image when images configured). Eleventy: _includes/** layouts. Next.js app router: metadata.twitter {card, title, description, images} and metadata.openGraph in app/**/layout.tsx|page.tsx (Next emits name="twitter:*"; whether Next.js derives twitter tags from openGraph depends on version, so inspect the build output if unsure); pages router: <Head> tags, next-seo DefaultSeo twitter config. Apply the rules above.

parity.note: Exact for literal tags. Differs for tags injected at runtime (react-helmet in SPAs), SEO plugins/framework defaults that emit tags not visible in source (Hugo internal templates, Next.js metadata merging, Astro SEO integrations), and template values that may render empty at build time.

fix_summary: Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">, twitter:title, twitter:description and twitter:image to the shared head layout, populated from the same variables as the page title/description/OG image (Next.js metadata.twitter, Hugo _internal/twitter_cards.html, Astro/Eleventy layout head).
